title: Krannert Center
text: The Krannert Center is a theater on the University of Illinois campus. It is near Champaign.

title: Alma Mater
text: The Alma Mater is a statue on the University of Illinois campus, between Champaign and Urbana.

title: Boneyard Creek
text: Boneyard Creek is a small river that runs through Champaign and Urbana.

title: Campustown
text: Campustown is an area of shops and restaurants in Champaign.

title: Carle Hospital
text: Carle Hospital is a hospital in Urbana, Illinois. It serves Champaign and nearby towns.

title: Illini Union
text: The Illini Union is the student union at the University of Illinois. It is close to downtown Champaign.

title: Green Street
text: Green Street is a main street in Champaign that goes through Campustown.

title: Memorial Stadium
text: Memorial Stadium is the football stadium for the Fighting Illini in Champaign.

title: Urbana
text: Urbana is a city in Illinois. It is right next to Champaign. It's nice to live there.

title: Champaign Public Library
text: The Champaign Public Library is the main library in the city of Champaign, Illinois.
